description: This file contains unit tests for the JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino class, focusing on sandboxing capabilities such as preventing malicious scripts from executing dangerous operations like exit, quit, infinite loops, recursion, and loading overly large scripts.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperRhinoSandboxingTest
classes.description: A final class containing JUnit test methods that validate sandboxing restrictions on JavaScript scripts executed by the message mapper, ensuring scripts cannot perform harmful operations.

methods.name: ensureExitForbidden
methods.description: Tests that a script calling 'exit(1);' results in a MessageMappingFailedException.

methods.name: ensureQuitForbidden
methods.description: Tests that a script calling 'quit(1);' results in a MessageMappingFailedException.

methods.name: ensureEndlessLoopGetsAborted
methods.description: Tests that an infinite loop in the script is aborted and raises an exception.

methods.name: ensureRecursionGetsAborted
methods.description: Tests that recursive function calls are aborted, preventing stack overflow or infinite recursion.

methods.name: ensureTooBigMappingScriptIsNotLoaded
methods.description: Verifies that scripts exceeding the maximum size are rejected when configuring the mapper.

methods.name: createMapper
methods.description: Helper method to create a MessageMapper instance with specified malicious script code for testing.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Constructs a dummy ExternalMessage with a UUID header and sample payload for testing.

methods.name: getMappingWrapperScript
methods.description: Generates a script string that includes malicious JavaScript code to test sandboxing restrictions.
